Brand.title: Our Story
Brand.intro: {storeName} is built around one idea: skincare that fits into your everyday routine, without the guesswork.
Brand.storyBody: We got tired of skincare that overpromises and overcomplicates. So we built a shop around a simple idea: fewer, better products, chosen with care, for the routine you actually have time for.
Brand.value1Body: We choose every product with care, so you can trust what you put on your skin.
Brand.value2Body: No 12-step regimens — just what you need, when you need it.
Brand.value3Body: Questions about a product or your order? Our team is always ready to help.

Accessibility.statementIntro: We're working to make this site usable for as many people as possible. Here's what's currently in place:
Accessibility.statementItemWidget: An accessibility toolbar (bottom corner of every page) for adjusting text size, enabling high contrast, and underlining links.
Accessibility.statementItemSemantic: Semantic HTML structure with labeled form fields and images.
Accessibility.statementItemRtl: Full right-to-left layout support for Hebrew and Arabic.
Accessibility.statementDisclaimer: This statement describes the measures currently implemented and is not a certified accessibility compliance audit.
